activity.notes: James VI of Scotland inherited the English throne on 24 March 1603 as James I and remained King of England until his death on 27 March 1625. The crowns were in personal union, but England and Scotland remained separate kingdoms, so ATLAS records this kingship independently of his existing Scottish Activity.

sources.title: James I (r. 1603-1625) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records that James VI of Scotland became King James I of England in 1603 and reigned until 1625.
